cards.example_en: Please leave those stinky shoes outside the front door.
cards.example_zh: 请把那些臭鞋放在前门外。
cards.explain_zh: 非正式用语；正式写作可用foul-smelling。

cards.example_en: Please leave those stinky shoes outside the front door.
cards.example_zh: 请把那些臭鞋放在前门外。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: My talented cousin painted this beautiful picture of our garden.
cards.example_zh: 我那位有绘画天赋的表亲画了这幅漂亮的花园图。
cards.explain_zh: talented强调天赋；skilled强调熟练技能。

cards.example_en: I felt jealous when my cousin got a bicycle.
cards.example_zh: 表弟得到一辆自行车时，我心里很嫉妒。
cards.explain_zh: 常用be jealous of；既可指嫉妒，也可指吃醋。

cards.example_en: She cracked the shell and ate the peanut inside.
cards.example_zh: 她剥开壳，吃掉了里面的花生米。
cards.explain_zh: 表示“极少的钱”时用复数peanuts，属非正式用法。

cards.example_en: We keep a first aid kit in the car.
cards.example_zh: 我们在车里备有一个急救包。
cards.explain_zh: kit指成套用品；kit sb out表示给某人配装备。

cards.example_en: We keep a first aid kit in the car.
cards.example_zh: 我们在车里备有一个急救包。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We walked farther along the beach before stopping for lunch.
cards.example_zh: 我们沿海滩又走了一段路才停下来吃午饭。
cards.explain_zh: farther多指实际距离；进一步讨论用further。

cards.example_en: Our landlady came round to fix the kitchen tap.
cards.example_zh: 我们的女房东过来修厨房水龙头。
cards.explain_zh: landlady指女性；landlord可泛指房东。

cards.example_en: Our hostess brought out fresh fruit after dinner.
cards.example_zh: 晚餐后，女主人端来了新鲜水果。
cards.explain_zh: hostess特指女性；host如今也可用于任何性别。

cards.example_en: Our easy-going neighbour never complains when our dog barks.
cards.example_zh: 我们随和的邻居从不因我们的狗叫而抱怨。
cards.explain_zh: 形容性格随和、不易生气，不表示懒惰。

cards.example_en: Her compliment about my cooking made me smile.
cards.example_zh: 她对我厨艺的称赞让我笑了。
cards.explain_zh: compliment是赞美；complement是补充、相辅相成。

cards.example_en: The shop gave me a refund for the broken kettle.
cards.example_zh: 商店把坏水壶的货款退给了我。
cards.explain_zh: 名词重音在前；动词读/rɪˈfʌnd/，重音在后。

cards.example_en: Airlines should offer passengers a full refund when flights are cancelled without reasonable alternatives.
cards.example_zh: 航班取消且没有合理的替代方案时，航空公司应向乘客提供全额退款。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: My sister practises gymnastics at the local sports centre.
cards.example_zh: 我姐姐在当地体育中心练体操。
cards.explain_zh: 虽以-s结尾，表示运动时作单数：gymnastics is。

cards.example_en: I listen to a cooking podcast while making dinner.
cards.example_zh: 我做晚饭时会听一档烹饪播客。
cards.explain_zh: 收听播客用listen to a podcast，别漏掉to。

cards.example_en: Please don't misunderstand me; I really want to help.
cards.example_zh: 请别误会我，我真的想帮忙。
cards.explain_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为misunderstood。

cards.example_en: I bought a bag of mixed nuts for our picnic.
cards.example_zh: 我买了一袋混合坚果，准备野餐时吃。
cards.explain_zh: mixed feelings指心情矛盾；mixed也是mix的过去分词。

cards.example_en: The introduction of online lessons received mixed reactions from students, parents, and teachers.
cards.example_zh: 学生、家长和教师对引入网课的反应褒贬不一。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Please add a pint of milk to the bowl.
cards.example_zh: 请往碗里加入一品脱牛奶。
cards.explain_zh: 英制品脱约568毫升，美制液量品脱约473毫升。

cards.example_en: Please add a pint of milk to the bowl.
cards.example_zh: 请往碗里加入一品脱牛奶。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: These two jackets look alike, but one feels warmer.
cards.example_zh: 这两件夹克看起来很像，但有一件穿着更暖和。
cards.explain_zh: 形容词通常放在系动词后，不放在名词前。

cards.example_en: These two jackets look alike, but one feels warmer.
cards.example_zh: 这两件夹克看起来很像，但有一件穿着更暖和。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Add a little vinegar to the salad dressing.
cards.example_zh: 往沙拉酱里加一点醋。
cards.explain_zh: 通常不可数，表示数量可用a bottle of vinegar。

cards.example_en: It felt chilly outside, so I grabbed my jacket.
cards.example_zh: 外面有些冷，所以我拿上了夹克。
cards.explain_zh: chilly比freezing程度轻，也可形容态度冷淡。

cards.example_en: Local businesses can bounce back after economic shocks if they receive timely financial support.
cards.example_zh: 如果及时获得资金支持，当地企业就能在经济冲击后恢复元气。
cards.explain_zh: bounce back既可指弹回，也常指受挫后恢复。

cards.example_en: Local businesses can bounce back after economic shocks if they receive timely financial support.
cards.example_zh: 如果及时获得资金支持，当地企业就能在经济冲击后恢复元气。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: After work, I enjoy a warm bath for relaxation.
cards.example_zh: 下班后，我喜欢泡个热水澡放松一下。
cards.explain_zh: 表示放松、休息时通常不可数：for relaxation。

cards.example_en: Schools should teach relaxation techniques to help students manage anxiety before important examinations.
cards.example_zh: 学校应教授放松技巧，帮助学生缓解重要考试前的焦虑。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I made a tuna sandwich for lunch today.
cards.example_zh: 我今天做了一个金枪鱼三明治当午餐。
cards.explain_zh: 指鱼肉时不可数；指鱼时复数通常仍为tuna。

cards.example_en: I made a tuna sandwich for lunch today.
cards.example_zh: 我今天做了一个金枪鱼三明治当午餐。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The plane made a smooth landing despite the wind.
cards.example_zh: 尽管有风，飞机还是平稳着陆了。
cards.explain_zh: 除“着陆”外，也指楼梯顶部或中间的平台。

cards.example_en: The plane made a smooth landing despite the wind.
cards.example_zh: 尽管有风，飞机还是平稳着陆了。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Her stylish green jacket looked great with plain trousers.
cards.example_zh: 她那件时髦的绿色夹克搭配素色长裤很好看。
cards.explain_zh: stylish强调时尚美观；不等于昂贵或奢华。

cards.example_en: She practises the flute by her bedroom window every afternoon.
cards.example_zh: 她每天下午都在卧室窗边练习长笛。
cards.explain_zh: 英式常称演奏者为flautist，美式常用flutist。

cards.example_en: Learning to play the flute can develop concentration and encourage children to participate in musical ensembles.
cards.example_zh: 学习吹长笛可以培养专注力，并鼓励儿童参加合奏团体。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: A small spider was crawling across the ceiling.
cards.example_zh: 一只小蜘蛛正爬过天花板。
cards.explain_zh: ceiling是室内天花板；roof是建筑外部的屋顶。

cards.example_en: The lake looks peaceful in the early morning light.
cards.example_zh: 晨光中的湖泊显得格外宁静。
cards.explain_zh: 可形容环境安静，也可指行动不使用暴力。

cards.example_en: The new neighbour seemed unfriendly but was simply shy.
cards.example_zh: 新邻居看似冷淡，其实只是害羞。
cards.explain_zh: 虽以-ly结尾，但通常是形容词，不是副词。

cards.example_en: A sudden clap of thunder made the windows shake.
cards.example_zh: 一声突如其来的雷鸣震得窗户直晃。
cards.explain_zh: thunder指雷声，通常不可数；lightning指闪电。

cards.example_en: She placed a delicate teacup beside the biscuit plate.
cards.example_zh: 她把一只精致的茶杯放在饼干盘旁。
cards.explain_zh: teacup是茶杯；a cup of tea是一杯茶。

cards.example_en: Students can upload their assignments to a secure platform, allowing teachers to provide timely feedback.
cards.example_zh: 学生可以将作业上传至安全平台，方便教师及时提供反馈。
cards.explain_zh: 上传用upload，下载用download；上传至某处用to。

cards.example_en: The bride held fresh flowers as she entered the garden.
cards.example_zh: 新娘手捧鲜花走进花园。
cards.explain_zh: bride指新娘，groom指新郎。

cards.example_en: I felt confused when both doors led outside.
cards.example_zh: 两扇门都通向外面，让我感到困惑。
cards.explain_zh: confused形容人困惑；confusing形容事物令人困惑。

cards.example_en: I made a reservation for dinner by the window.
cards.example_zh: 我预订了一个靠窗的位置吃晚饭。
cards.explain_zh: 表示疑虑常用复数：have reservations about。

cards.example_en: The goat caught its horn in the fence.
cards.example_zh: 那只山羊的角卡在了栅栏里。
cards.explain_zh: 动物的角和车辆喇叭都用horn，均为可数名词。

cards.example_en: We watched a narrow boat glide along the canal.
cards.example_zh: 我们看着一艘窄船沿运河缓缓驶过。
cards.explain_zh: canal通常为人工水道；river指天然河流。

cards.example_en: We watched the wildlife quietly from behind the trees.
cards.example_zh: 我们躲在树后，静静地观察野生动物。
cards.explain_zh: 不可数名词；wildlife park中作名词定语。

cards.example_en: Their cottage has a tiny garden full of roses.
cards.example_zh: 他们的乡间小屋有一个种满玫瑰的小花园。
cards.explain_zh: 通常指乡间小住宅，不等同于豪华的villa。

word.example_en: I bought a bag of mixed nuts for our picnic.
word.example_zh: 我买了一袋混合坚果，准备野餐时吃。
